description: Close codes of relay protocol 2 (relay-protocol.md § 3). The close reason string is `name`. Entries with a null name are standard codes with no relay-specific reason.

codes.name: protocol_error
codes.condition: Invalid first frame, wrong `v`, malformed `sessionId`, a client frame before `relay_paired`

codes.name: daemon_offline
codes.condition: No control socket for the session id

codes.name: daemon_unresponsive
codes.condition: The daemon did not attach within 10 s

codes.name: too_many_clients
codes.condition: The session id already has 32 connections

codes.name: daemon_outdated
codes.condition: No control socket, but a silent old-protocol socket is parked under the session id

codes.name: unknown_connection
codes.condition: The `connectionId` is not waiting: the client left, or the id is wrong

codes.name: replaced
codes.condition: A newer control socket registered the same session id

codes.name: peer_closed
codes.condition: The other half closed with a code that cannot be forwarded

codes.name: channel_error
codes.condition: A channel frame failed: authentication, order, format
A frame above the 100 MiB frame-size limit (message too big)
The relay is shutting down (going away)
